The technical picture shows extreme capitulation, highlighted by a deeply oversold RSI14 of 19.49 and a massive 20-day decline of -31.66% that has broken below the 20-day low of 11.26. With a high ATR of 0.8179 (7.93% atr_pct) and a volume ratio of 1.57, selling pressure is exhausted and primed for a sharp snap-back rally toward moving average resistance. Furthermore, Wall Street analysts remain overwhelmingly bullish with 4 strong buys, 9 buys, and only 1 hold, providing fundamental backing for an oversold rebound.
